facts.claim: Thana has been a municipal town since 1863, with an average income during the decade ending 1901 of Rs. 37,000.

facts.claim: The chief educational institutions are the Bairamjl Jijibhoy High School opened in 1880, an English school for girls, and an English middle school for boys.
